summary: The reconfiguration run (CheckRun 80dff94385c248ac9a78c912b65c617c) held all three comparisons: both live participants report the decided StopSign and reject further proposals (event 12), and the participant absent at decision time learns the StopSign and catches up after recovery (event 13). Recorded that as a new sourced question on the authority-transition axis with a question-level account (no defect claim, joint-history reasoning for reusing the other investigation's experiment), and submitted a further harness case that starts the configuration named by the StopSign (fresh instances, configuration_id 2, four entries) to measure the transition itself, with its own admission event and two comparisons.
